programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Blackmail
programme.desc: Dev discovers that his wife, Reena, has been cheating on him with Ranjit. To teach them a lesson, he decides to blackmail the cheating duo as part of his revenge.

programme.title: Satya
programme.desc: Durga's brother is killed in a gang war, turning him into a revenge-seeking man with a mission. Now, his ex-girlfriends cop husband is out to get him. Finally, the two team up to nab the real culprit.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Khwaja Mere Khwaja
programme.desc: The plot follows the downfall of the Quadri family due to betrayal and their subsequent pursuit of peace.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Keemat
programme.desc: Two crooks accidentally kill a man and decide to inform his parents about the bad news. However, once they meet the family, they end up lying to them.

programme.desc: Hartford, Connecticut. Adam Richman is off to Hartford, Connecticut for some humongous hot dogs, steamed cheeseburgers, and a ten-pound super-stuffed pizza challenge. S2, Ep20

programme.desc: Salt Lake City. Adam Richman journeys to Salt Lake City, Utah, for a unique pastrami-topped cheeseburger, a Belgian sausage sandwich and a diabolically spicy Hellfire Challenge. S2, Ep22

programme.desc: Origin: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday week by joining him on his travels to the Galapagos as he charted the archipelago's rise from the ocean millions of years ago. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Adaptation: In celebration of his 100th birthday, join Sir David Attenborough as he discovered unique species, showing how life adapted to the islands' shifting landscapes. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: Evolution: Celebrate Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he explored unusual Galapagos species, including giant tortoise Lonesome George. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: The Queen is Back: Feel the heat as Lizzie and veterinarian Joares scramble to collar more jaguars amid storms, floods and power outages. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: How Smart Are Sharks?: Often wrongly portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Carpathian Predators
programme.desc: Realm of the Bear: See the Carpathian mountains - where vast forests, steep gorges, and isolated peaks offer refuge to some of Europe's most charismatic creatures. (1 of 2)

programme.title: Carpathian Predators
programme.desc: New & Exclusive. Realm of the Wolf: In the Carpathian mountains lives one of nature's most misunderstood creatures - the Eurasian wolf. See the role these wolves play in the area. (2 of 2)

programme.title: Shark Squad
programme.desc: How Smart Are Sharks?: Often wrongly portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack
programme.desc: The Lost Boy: Join the Manzi pack at a kill, watch for leopards and hyenas with the Kakuli pack, then go on an epic hunt with a returning male of the Stork Colony. (S1, ep 5)

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Running With The Pack
programme.desc: Here Comes the Rain: Join Julz as he says an emotional farewell to the dog packs. And before you leave, make sure to go on a final hunt or two... (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand
programme.desc: Qatar: Pearls In The Sand: Explore a land of extremes. From Qatar's wild deserts to rare wildlife, see how human innovation reshapes a fragile landscape under climate threat. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue
programme.desc: Te Tau Ihu/ Top of the South: Traverse one of the longest natural sandbars side-by-side with pilot whales, then swim amongst dolphins and fur seals through drowned river valleys. (3 of 6)

programme.title: Beasts Of The Big Blue
programme.desc: Te Moananui a Toi/ Hauraki Gulf: Take a deep dive into the teeming waters of the Hauraki Gulf and swim alongside a stealthy manta ray, dolphins and a kaleidoscope of tropical fish. (4 of 6)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Delve into the surprising behaviours of some of Australia's most unlikely romantics, including shingleback lizards, eastern ospreys, brown boobys and even corals. (S1, ep 9)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Many scientists believe curiosity is a key driving force in evolution. Meet some uniquely curious animals, including brushtail possums, parrots, numbats and more. (S1, ep 10)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Disorganised: Explore how being disorganised works in our fauna's favour. A chaotic approach to life can help a species get ahead in a land of extremes. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Extraordinary Animals
programme.desc: Obsessive: In the wild, being obsessive isn't a flaw, it's a means of survival. The animals of this brutal continent know that obsession equals success. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Explore Tasmanian devils' softer side, meet a pioneering sea turtle, enjoy family dinner with Buttons the deer and play football with 800-kilogram Spud the bull. (3 of 6)

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Flap around with Banksi the fruit bat, celebrate a pig's rescue-versary and learn to speak baboon with Dingani, who has a one-of-a-kind kinship with his primate pal Lucy. (4 of 6)

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: Autumn: The autumn season brings fresh opportunities for creatures including seals, chameleons and monkeys. Plus, rare creatures begin to reveal themselves. (Ep 3 of 4)

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: Winter: The Southern African winter brings drought, ice and storms. As animals battle the elements, they face more competition amongst themselves. (Ep 4 of 4)

programme.title: Leopard Dynasty: The Rise of Rana
programme.desc: Jhalana's leopard kingdom trembles as Prince Rana challenges his father Bahadur, forging a dangerous alliance to seize power by claw and fang.

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last Of The Giants
programme.desc: The Americas: Patrick Aryee checks out the biggest animals on Earth as he reveals why size matters in the natural world. First stop, the Americas. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last Of The Giants
programme.desc: Australia and Asia: Patrick Aryee gets eye to eye with Komodo dragons, orangutans and giant pandas as he explores why these creatures all came to be supersized. (2 of 3)

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last Of The Giants
programme.desc: Africa: Patrick Aryee tracks down great white sharks, desert giraffes and one of the last 'tusker' elephants as he explores the challenges facing nature's giants. (3 of 3)

programme.title: New: Wild Science
programme.desc: Black Rhino: Track the black rhino's evolution through adaptation and conservation. Discover the powerful senses and survival traits of this armoured giant. (S1, ep 4)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Courtship: Dating is just as tricky a business in the insect world, and Sir David Attenborough finds out how certain bugs choose and then woo their partners. (Ep 3 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Reproduction: Sir David Attenborough reveals how different bugs usher in the next generation, including the butterfly and harvestman spider. (Ep 4 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Family: Join Sir David Attenborough as he zooms in on a set of bugs who prefer cooperation to conflict, from the burrowing cockroach to a queen bee. (Ep 5 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Colony: Before departing the insect world, Sir David Attenborough takes a tour of its vast colonies, which rival human megacities in both size and complexity. (Ep 6 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Dragons And Damsels
programme.desc: They are beautiful, their behaviour is as complex as mammals and they have existed since the dinosaurs. David Attenborough uncovers the life of dragonflies and damselflies.
